_source: Placement library (4/N). Planet-in-sign interpretation keyed "{Planet}:{Sign}" (9 grahas x 12 rashis = 108). Complements kb_planet_in_house: the house says WHERE a graha acts, the sign says HOW it expresses. Composed from the graha karaka function, the rashi expression mode and classical dignity (exaltation/debilitation/own), which is how the classical texts derive it. Payload { text, dignity }. English-authored; run `npm run kb:backfill -- --tables=planet-in-sign`.

en.text: Your sense of self, authority and vitality express through sharp, initiating fire — fast to start, impatient with delay. This is Sun's sign of exaltation — the placement operates at full strength, and its qualities show up early and reliably.

Your sense of self, authority and vitality express through steady, sensory earth — slow to move, immovable once settled. Sun is a guest here: neither strengthened nor undermined, so surrounding aspects and the house it occupies decide the outcome.

Your sense of self, authority and vitality express through restless, dual air — curious, verbal, quick to switch. Sun is a guest here: neither strengthened nor undermined, so surrounding aspects and the house it occupies decide the outcome.

Your sense of self, authority and vitality express through protective, tidal water — feeling first, guarded and retentive. Sun is a guest here: neither strengthened nor undermined, so surrounding aspects and the house it occupies decide the outcome.

Your sense of self, authority and vitality express through proud, radiant fire — needing to be seen and to matter. Sun rules this sign, so it is at home — comfortable, self-directed and stable rather than spectacular.

Your sense of self, authority and vitality express through analytical, corrective earth — precise, useful, quietly critical. Sun is a guest here: neither strengthened nor undermined, so surrounding aspects and the house it occupies decide the outcome.

Your sense of self, authority and vitality express through balancing, relational air — weighing, pairing, averse to discord. This is Sun's sign of debilitation — the function is under strain here, and matures late or through difficulty. Check for neecha bhanga (cancellation), which often turns it into a defining strength.
